_about: Rain Print for Canada (components/rp-canada.js). Canadian GHCN-Daily stations with rain reports since 2000: ECCC climate stations (src C) and CoCoRaHS Canada gauges (src N). q: one letter a year from y0 (a: rain and snowfall whole, at most 10 days missing; b: rain whole, no snowfall record; c: 11 to 31 days missing; -: more than 31 or none). nm: 1991-2020 monthly normals in mm computed from the station's own whole months (ny years at least in every month), not ECCC's published normals. Built by scripts/build_rp_canada.py from NOAA GHCN-Daily on S3 (noaa-ghcn-pds).
